fail.text: Reroll failed — use the new result.

success.text: Reroll succeeded — use the new result.

automation.text: Replace this with a manual reroll of the original save. The save node above is just a roller — substitute the stat and DC of the failed save by editing the action, or use `!s <stat>` directly. Unbreakable also grants permanent **Advantage** on Str/Dex/Con saves (passive — apply with `-adv` on `!s`).
